decisions.reason: The chair family is close to the core offer and serves both residential and contract customers, so it is worth keeping despite its reduced web visibility since 2020.
The floor cushions depended on the rug material base that was discontinued with the rug collection, leaving a niche accessory with little strategic fit.
The sofa only ever had a weak web presence and no visible emphasis since, so freeing its resources for stronger upholstery lines or new development makes sense.
The high standing table fits the flexible workplace and lounge direction and costs little to keep in the range.
